messages:
nina: Hey folks, first-day onboarding question. VPN shows connected but I can't reach our internal VPC endpoints (10.22.x.x). Registry and bastion host are unreachable. Any quick debugging tips?

netbot: Hi @nina — please ping @oliver (netops) and @tara (IT). Onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/vpn.

oliver: Welcome! Two quick checks: `netstat -rn | grep 10.` to see routes and `scutil --dns` (mac) to confirm corporate DNS. Also confirm client version.

nina: macOS 13.6, VPN client SecureConn 4.0.0. `netstat -rn | grep 10.` shows no 10.22 route. Client says split-tunnel enabled.

tara: If split-tunnel is on, internal prefixes should be pushed. We sometimes have a mismatch for the SecureConn 4.x family. Can you try toggling "Route all traffic" in client prefs to test?

nina: toggled -> still no route. `dig bastion.redwood.internal` -> NXDOMAIN.

oliver: Sounds like DNS push isn't applied. Two immediate workarounds: 1) SSH via public jump host (ssh -J nina@jump.pub.redwood ubuntu@10.22.5.2) — I'll open a short firewall exception for your IP. 2) I can add 10.22.0.0/16 to the push list for your profile. Which do you prefer?

nina: firewall exception would be great so I can grab the docker image. Thanks.

oliver: Done, 30m window opened. Try `ssh -v -J nina@jump.pub.redwood ubuntu@10.22.5.2` and paste output if it fails.

nina: SSH connects now but docker pull hangs at TLS handshake. `curl -v https://registry.int.redwood:5000/v2/` shows certificate CN = registry.internal, host is registry.int.redwood -> mismatch.

tara: That happens when split DNS leaks or we hit an older cert. I'll request a short-lived SAN update for `registry.int.redwood` and we'll add the registry IP to the certificate altNames. Ticket ONB-4892 opened.

oliver: Also reduced MTU on the tunnel sometimes helps TLS issues: `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400`. I pushed the 10.22 route for your profile; restart the client in ~2m.

nina: Restarted, routes present, DNS resolving, docker pull works. Thanks for the speedy help!

tara: Great. Follow-up: Nina, we'll add a checklist entry to onboarding for client version, `netstat` output, and public IP. Company-managed device recommended, BYOD allowed with extra steps.

nina: Noted. Appreciate the help :smile:
